title: Prime Minister shares an article by Deputy Chief Minister of Maharashtra Shri Eknath Shinde highlighting PM Modi's 25 years in public life dedicated to service, development and nation-building
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, has shared an article written by the Deputy Chief Minister of Maharashtra, Shri Eknath Shinde. In the article, Shri Eknath Shinde writes that PM Modi's 25 years in public life reflect a journey of service, development and nation-building. It highlights that from Gujarat to Delhi, the focus on infrastructure, technology, welfare and cultural heritage has shaped India's development journey, pointing out that the next phase looks towards Viksit Bharat 2047, with a vision of a stronger and self-reliant India. The Prime Minister’s Office posted on X: “PM @narendramodi's 25 years in public life reflect a journey of service, development and nation-building, writes Maharashtra Deputy CM Shri @mieknathshinde. From Gujarat to Delhi, the focus on infrastructure, technology, welfare and cultural heritage has shaped India's development journey. The next phase looks towards Viksit Bharat 2047, with a vision of a stronger and self-reliant India.”
